brief:
Execute docs/research/dtf-migration-gap-closure-plan-20261116/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, identity dtf-migration-gap-closure-plan-20261116-final, in /Users/cyotee/Projects/indexedex.

Repair source for freshly built instances only. No commit, push, dependency installation, public transaction, live-deployment upgrade, or new production authority. Preserve the November 15 scope: original-wallet eligibility, source-native custody, the NFT 3 split, TokenStaking conserved originals, full-original manual pricing, keep-until-reloaded credit, immutable issuance, funded fresh cliffs, real paid owner-first activation, reward gates, and irreversible selector removal.

Do not restore the operator application, portable bundles, journals, holder ancestry, automatic pricing capture, a mandatory NFT wrapper, or the rejected TokenStaking adapter dependency.

Use forge commands with --use solar and python3 scripts/forge-artifacts.py. Keep configured out/ and cache_forge/. Seed any new worktree from the warm checkout before the first compile. Do not run two writers against the same artifact directories.

assumed: land verified worktree diffs onto the integration working tree without a git commit — the plan forbids commits and the session hard limit requires an explicit user commit request; reversible if the user explicitly asks for commits.

assumed: team mode stays off — F1, F3, and P1 own disjoint files, so parallel task workers finish sooner than a team; reversible if a later discovery shows those files must be edited together.

assumed: code-changing goals use one git worktree per lane off the integration base, with warm out/ and cache_forge seeding — the loop contract requires worktrees and the plan permits a worktree when chosen; reversible by staying in the primary checkout if worktree creation fails.

- Record scope baseline — the new timestamped directory under docs/incidents/2026-09-16-dtf-recovery/migration/gap-closure-20261116 identifies gaps F1, F2, F3, P1, and F4, the owned source files, Forge and Solar versions, foundry.toml out and cache_forge paths, and source hashes, and labels historical 236/183/28641 results as unrepaired baselines. WHEN TO STOP: stop right away when source-manifest.json and baseline.md exist in that directory and claim no repaired-source result.
- Author F1 F3 P1 repairs — F1 extends sweepDust in contracts/vaults/detf/protocols/dexes/uniswap/v4/migration/UniswapV4DetfMigrationMaintenanceFacet.sol, declares MigrationCapitalReleasedToResidual on contracts/vaults/detf/protocols/dexes/uniswap/v4/migration/interfaces/IUniswapV4DetfMigration.sol, and adds MigrationDonationRemainder.t.sol plus the MigrationRecoveryDonation fork witness. F3 sets migrationPresentation and activation-based rewardsClosed in UniswapV4DetfMigrationBondMetadataTarget.sol and contracts/vaults/detf/common/bondNft/DETFFundedBondMetadata.sol without changing claim arithmetic. P1 adds observedHook on TestBase_UniswapV4DetfMigrationSnapshot.sol and MigrationRawWeightedPricing.t.sol, using a separate production Weighted hook as the gross oracle. WHEN TO STOP: stop right away when C2, C3, and C4 each exit 0 and those diffs are on the integration working tree with no commit.
- Repair native owner purchase — add buyOwnerFirstBond to scripts/foundry/recovery/dtf-migration/MigrationCoreLocalQA.s.sol so Stage A makes one real pairA, 1 ether, 90-day controller purchase, Stage B is called with the parent address, and the production activation guard and stage signatures stay unchanged. Prove it with test/foundry/spec/vaults/detf/protocols/dexes/uniswap/v4/migration/MigrationCoreLocalQA.t.sol. WHEN TO STOP: stop right away when C5 exits 0 for honest payment, missing-purchase rejection, and atomic rollback.
- Verify integrated native lifecycle — on the landed source, forge build --use solar, the hermetic forge test --use solar, and the pinned fork suite under test/foundry/fork/vaults/detf/protocols/dexes/uniswap/v4/migration pass with nonzero new counts; a fresh nonforked Anvil then mines deployAndIssue and exerciseAfterCliff with successful receipts, queried bond IDs, explicit sweep LP progress, and rendered tokenURI SVGs. WHEN TO STOP: stop right away when the C6 logs, C7 receipts, and metadata captures are saved and the owned Anvil is stopped.
- Publish current evidence navigation — prepend current links to docs/incidents/2026-09-16-dtf-recovery/migration/verification.md, quote-evidence.md, source-route-matrix.md, recovery-route-disposition.md, and foundry-runbook.md, keep every historical body verbatim, and write the run verification.md that closes F1, F2, F3, P1, or F4 only when its new evidence exists. WHEN TO STOP: stop right away when every plan-named entry links current commands, results, models, measured gas, and unresolved limits.

Activation and the principal claim mined. sweepDust reverted RateProviderFailed twice, using 31391954 and 31483922 gas, both under the 32000000 node cap. The cap was not raised. Metadata captures are post-claim and pre-sweep.

successCriteria.scenario: FOUNDRY_PROFILE=fork python3 scripts/forge-artifacts.py test of the pinned K migration suite exits 0, or the log names a preexisting failure without calling an unavailable fork a success. Hung-command and flaky-RPC classes apply: wait for exit, do not kill for silence, and do not change the pin to obtain a pass.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: FOUNDRY_PROFILE=fork python3 scripts/forge-artifacts.py test on the pinned migration fork root exited 0: 31 suites, 184 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. This is an in-process fork, not a public broadcast.

goals.failureReason: C001 and C003 passed. C002 failed: deployAndIssue mined and the cliff, activation, and principal claim mined, but sweepDust reverted RateProviderFailed under the 32,000,000 cap. The cap was not raised. Receipts and post-claim SVGs are saved. The owned Anvil was stopped. This does not authorize a node-limit increase or a claim that the native lifecycle passed.
